name: Navdio
author: megaturtl
description: Broadcast a selected Navidrome user's playback through a local Navdio companion.

users.reason: Read playback for the selected user and request cover art as that user. Grant only the broadcast user.

library.reason: Read the relative file path and library ID for playback reports. Grant only broadcast libraries.

subsonicapi.reason: Read a 50-pixel cover using the internal getCoverArt endpoint.

scheduler.reason: Send a liveness heartbeat every five seconds.

cache.reason: Cache bounded cover images per user and track.

http.reason: Send authenticated playback events to the loopback companion only.

username.title: Broadcast username
username.description: Exact Navidrome username. Configure user and library grants separately.

player.title: Player filter
player.description: Optional case-insensitive exact player name. Empty selects all this user's players.

companionUrl.title: Companion origin
companionUrl.description: HTTP(S) origin using the literal loopback host 127.0.0.1 or [::1], without credentials, path, query, or fragment.

token.title: Companion event token
token.description: Secret shared with the companion. Configure at runtime. Do not put it in source control.
